tailoring.headline: Full Stack Java Developer – SAP Commerce Cloud & Microservices
tailoring.summary: Backend and frontend engineer with 5+ years delivering enterprise e-commerce platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, microservices and REST/OCC APIs, with hands-on experience in JavaScript-based PWA frontends. Proven track record in CI/CD pipelines, Docker/Kubernetes cloud deployments, SQL database design and performance tuning. Strong agile collaborator, skilled in code reviews, testing with JUnit, and techno-functional analysis bridging business and IT.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Full Stack Developer - Customer Account (m/f/d)
cover_en.hook: I am excited to join Tchibo because its commitment to innovative e-commerce aligns with my passion for building customer-centric digital experiences. With over five years designing and operating SAP Commerce Cloud solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I have delivered robust microservices, APIs and front-end integrations that directly support seamless customer journeys.

bullets.label: Microservices Design
bullets.text: Designed and built scalable microservices on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java, Spring Boot and Docker/Kubernetes, ensuring high performance and reliability for customer account functions.

bullets.label: Full-Stack Delivery
bullets.text: Implemented end-to-end features spanning backend Java services and JavaScript-based PWA front-ends, exposing OCC REST APIs that power registration, login and account management.

bullets.label: CI/CD & Cloud Ops
bullets.text: Led CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins and Git, deploying containerised services to cloud environments via Kubernetes, and maintained production stability through proactive monitoring.

bullets.label: Agile Collaboration
bullets.text: Worked in international Scrum teams, conducting code reviews, writing JUnit tests and translating business requirements into functional specifications and user stories.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, I hold a valid German work permit, am serving notice until 15 December 2026 and can start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to Tchibo’s customer account platform.

tailoring.why_company: Tchibo’s reputation as one of Germany’s leading e-commerce brands and its culture of continuous digital innovation inspire me. The company’s focus on sustainable, customer-first solutions matches my experience delivering high-quality, scalable commerce platforms. I am eager to bring my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise and full-stack background to help Tchibo enhance its customer account services and drive the next wave of digital growth.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to help Tchibo create seamless, secure customer account experiences by applying my 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud and full-stack development expertise in a forward-thinking e-commerce environment.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years building microservices and full-stack e-commerce solutions. I’m excited about Tchibo’s innovative customer-account team and would love to discuss how I can add value.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Full Stack Developer – Customer Account (Tchibo GmbH)
tailoring.email_body: Dear Hiring Team, please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Full Stack Developer – Customer Account position at Tchibo. With over five years of experience delivering SAP Commerce Cloud microservices and full-stack solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am confident I can contribute to your team’s success. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my fit further.
